name: 81611 · Aspen, CO
findings: ZIP 81611 (Aspen) has 125 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Foundation organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 81611 (Aspen) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
57% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 81611 (Aspen) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
